title: Batteries
readOnly: You can see where the batteries are, but not change anything.
noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.description: Your role does not include the batteries module. An admin can enable it in Settings → Household → Roles and permissions.
pools.title: Stock
pools.empty.title: No batteries yet
pools.empty.description: Add your stock first, for example 24 AAA Duracell Recharge. They start as unaccounted for until you say where they are.
pool.breakdown: {{total}} = {{device}} in devices · {{charger}} in the charger · {{drawer}} in the drawer · {{missing}} unaccounted for
places.title: Where they are
places.empty.title: No places yet
places.empty.description: Put batteries in a device, the charger or the drawer, and each place shows up here with how long they have been there.
form.place.title: Put batteries in a place
form.place.label: Place
form.place.hint: A device, the charger or the drawer. A place you used before fills in the rest.
form.kindNew: Kind, if it is a new place
form.from.label: Taken from
form.from.auto: The drawer, or unaccounted for if there is no drawer
form.from.hint: Into a device they come out of the drawer by default.
form.to.label: To
form.to.hint: The exact name of a place, or a new one. Moving to “Sin ubicar” means they are lost.
form.oldTo.label: The old ones go to
form.newQuantity.label: How many new ones
form.newQuantity.hint: Leave empty for the same number.
form.change.lead: The new ones come out of the drawer, dated today.
form.discard.lead: Discarded batteries are dead: the stock total goes down. Lost ones are moved to “Sin ubicar” instead.
stock.kind.label: Size
stock.line.label: Line
stock.total.label: How many you own
stock.total.hint: The difference with the known places becomes “unaccounted for”.
confirm.archive: Archive this stock? Its places are closed and kept in the history.
confirm.discard: Discard these batteries? The stock total goes down.
history.title: History of this place
error.load: The batteries could not be loaded.
error.stock_exceeded: There are not that many there (available: {{available}}). The numbers above are up to date again.
error.insufficient_drawer: The drawer does not have enough: {{needed}} needed, {{available}} there. Say where they came from, or fill the drawer first.
error.ambiguous_target: That name matches more than one place or stock. Be more specific.
error.pool_exists: That stock already exists. Add to its total instead.
error.allocation_closed: That place has no batteries any more. The list is up to date again.
error.pool_not_found: That stock does not exist or was archived.
error.request_id_reused: This form was already sent with other values. Close it and try again.
error.session: Your session expired or could not be verified. Reload the page.
